crossRefs.note: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
Now I tell you, withdraw from these men, and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be…

translations.web: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
translations.bsb: So then, by their fruit you will recognize them.
translations.kjv: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
translations.asv: Therefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
